Definition: of uncertain affinity; Samus, an island of the Mediterranean:--Samos.
BiblicalUsage: Samos is an island in the Mediterranean, visited by Paul. You find the name in Acts 20:15: "…sailed thence, and came the next over against…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Samos matters because God marks the places of his story, one by one. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
